purpose: Freeze exact semantic definitions, finite reference semantics, complexity firewalls and proof-carrying partial-classifier outputs for F3D-D1 without assuming a polynomial-time total semantic oracle.

frozen_objects.root_variables: explicit finite Boolean variable set R
frozen_objects.locality_hypergraph: explicit finite list H={V_i subseteq R}
frozen_objects.b2_gate: e := signed_literal(a) AND signed_literal(b), with topological freshness
frozen_objects.root_restriction: partial assignment rho on root variables only
frozen_objects.residual_function: exact Boolean function f_u^rho on free roots
frozen_objects.essential_support: variables whose single-bit cofactor change can change the residual function
frozen_objects.semantic_fingerprint: complete truth table under one fixed free-root ordering; finite-reference only

crossing_witness.pair_condition: alpha_i and beta_i agree on V_i but output values differ
crossing_witness.verification: evaluate explicit B2 DAG on both assignments and verify projection equality plus output inequality
crossing_witness.claim: sound certificate that the function is not local to any listed neighborhood

local_certificate.finite_fixture_mode: complete truth-table plus exact essential-support computation
local_certificate.general_mode: formal equivalence/dependency certificate with separately specified verifier

complexity_firewall.truth_table_reference_cost: O(S * 2^r) where r is the number of free roots and S is explicit DAG gate count
complexity_firewall.consequence_if_polytime_total_exact_clas: would place coNP-complete circuit-unsatisfiability/equivalence tasks in P and therefore collapse P, NP and coNP

claim_ceiling: finite exhaustive semantics proves only finite fixture mechanics
coNP-completeness barrier is a complexity classification, not P!=NP
D1 does not establish a universal semantic survival theorem
D1 does not establish unrestricted ER3 or ER lower bounds
